overview: Global markets face ongoing volatility with continued tech sector sell-offs and new policy threats affecting data centers and artificial intelligence. Commercial real estate professionals are monitoring debt markets and evaluating how the industry can withstand shifting interest rate environments. In San Francisco, major tech company developments and IPO activities are intersecting with local housing market dynamics and downtown conditions. Meanwhile, Hawaii developments focus on state governance, university policy changes, and ongoing environmental and infrastructure oversight.

items.title: Anthropic Shares Slip as AI and Tech Stock Sell-Off Continues
items.summary: Anthropic shares slipped as the S&P 500 neared a market correction amid a broader AI and tech stock sell-off.

items.title: CRE Positioned to Withstand 2022 Repeat Amid Rising Rates: NYU Schack Panelists
items.summary: Debt investors at an NYU Schack panel noted that commercial real estate is better equipped today to avoid the market dislocation seen in 2022.

items.title: Anthropic’s IPO is here. Is San Francisco’s housing market about to pop?
items.summary: Anthropic's public offering has raised questions among observers about whether San Francisco's housing market is poised for significant changes.

items.title: S.F. protesters arrested at Anthropic HQ during IPO day
items.summary: Demonstrators were arrested outside of Anthropic's San Francisco headquarters during the company's IPO day.

items.title: Thirty Meter Telescope Gets New Life With Hawaiʻi Regents’ Vote
items.summary: The Thirty Meter Telescope received a fresh path forward following a recent vote by the Hawaii Regents.

items.title: University of Hawaiʻi Regents Approve Tuition Hikes For 2029 — And Beyond
items.summary: University of Hawaii Regents approved undergraduate resident tuition hikes for 2029 and beyond, with Mānoa approaching $13,000.

wiki.title: Tôn Thất Đính
wiki.extract: Lieutenant General Tôn Thất Đính was an officer who served in the Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN). He was one of the key figures in the November 1963 coup that led to the arrest and assassination of Ngô Đình Diệm, the first president of the Republic of Vietnam, commonly known as South Vietnam.

otd.text: Suicide bombers blew up the British consulate and the headquarters of HSBC Bank in Istanbul, killing 31 people, including consul general Roger Short and actor Kerem Yılmazer.
